test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 23 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Six friends, G, H, I, Q, R and S, are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. Only two people sit between G and S when counted from the right of G. Only one person sits between S and I when counted from the right of I. Only three people sit between G and R. H sits to the immediate left of Q. Who sits third to the left of R?1603
solution: **Given:** • Only two people sit between G and S when counted from the right of G. • Only one person sits between S and I when counted from the right of I. • Only three people sit between G and R. • H sits to the immediate left of Q.
